title: JaxMARL-BC: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Macroeconomic Modelling, in Seconds
abstract: arXiv:2610.28907v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) offers a principled way of populating simulated economies with many heterogeneous decision makers. Its adoption, pioneered in finance, has nonetheless been slow in macroeconomics because of two main limitations: the lack of a shared frame of reference connecting MARL systems to dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) models the profession already trusts, and the very long training times. The first limitation was recently addressed by the Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Business Cycle (MARL-BC), which places deep RL households in a real business cycle economy and reduces to classic DSGE models in specific limits. Here we address the second limitation. We present JaxMARL-BC, a JAX-accelerated simulator that trains MARL-BC economies in seconds (between 75x and 724x faster than the reference implementation), and scales to 200,000 independent learning households. translated_title: JaxMARL-BC：用于宏观经济建模的多智能体强化学习，只需数秒
translated_abstract: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）为在模拟经济中引入大量异质决策者提供了一种有原则的方法。尽管该方法在金融领域率先得到应用，但其在宏观经济学中的推广一直较为缓慢，原因主要有两点：一是缺乏一个共享的参照框架，将MARL系统与学界已经信赖的动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型联系起来；二是训练时间过长。第一个局限最近已由多智能体强化学习经济周期模型（MARL-BC）解决，该模型将深度强化学习家庭置于实际经济周期经济体中，并在特定极限条件下可还原为经典的DSGE模型。本文则解决了第二个局限。我们提出了JaxMARL-BC，一个基于JAX加速的模拟器，可以在数秒内完成MARL-BC经济体的训练（比参考实现快75倍至724倍），并可扩展至200,000个独立学习的家庭。我们验证了其正确性……
tldr: 本文提出基于JAX加速的模拟器JaxMARL-BC，将MARL-BC经济体的训练速度提升75至724倍、缩短至数秒内，并可扩展至20万个独立学习的家庭，解决了MARL在宏观经济学中应用的主要瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper presents JaxMARL-BC, a JAX-accelerated simulator that trains MARL-BC economies in seconds (75x to 724x faster than the reference implementation) and scales to 200,000 independent learning households, addressing the key bottleneck of MARL adoption in macroeconomics.
